d:
Gaata Rahe Mera Dil from the evergreen classic Guide (1965) is one of Hindi cinema’s most joyful romantic duets. Picturised on the charming Dev Anand and the graceful Waheeda Rehman, this song beautifully captures the carefree spirit of love and togetherness. Sung melodiously by Kishore Kumar and Lata Mangeshkar, and composed by the legendary S.D. Burman, the song remains timeless even decades later.
